      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",

      "status_by_id": "rc:4128325049",

      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",

      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author added read-ahead disabling to feature_proxy.py",

        "r:5359374237"

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "r:5359374237",

      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Use BOOST_REQUIRE instead of Assert so test failures report cleanly and do not abort test_bitcoin prematurely",

      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained preferring Assert as a simple precondition check",

        "rc:4139041469"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4139041469",
      "status_by_quote": "I consider the loaded block a precondition for the hash comparison, so I used Assert() deliberately to keep it a simple one-liner."
    },

      "type": "suggestion",

      "status_note": "author renamed the configuration option to -blockreadaheadthreads",
      "author_replies": [
        "r:5359374237"

      "other_replies": [],

      "status_by_id": "r:5359374237",
